mostWorthwhile.text: Freeing the ancient light was most worthwhile: it connected neutral hydrogen to reduced scattering and clarified that transparency preceded the first stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making neutral helium felt least involving because the introduction supplied the sequence and the action was straightforward.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a bound gas region need not expand with the universe, and that it must lose heat to contract much further.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had understandable purposes, though compatibility was supplied by the menu.

continue.text: Yes. The concise explanations made me curious how the gas develops into stars and eventually a world.
